name: Atomic Smash Lab
summary:
# Your living room is now a laboratory.

**Atomic Smash Lab** turns your real space into a holographic chemistry playground. Reach into a floating periodic table of all **118 elements**, pull real atoms into the air, and smash them together to build actual molecules — water, caffeine, table salt, rust, even uranium hexafluoride.

## What you do
- **Pull fully-formed atoms** off the table, built to the real Bohr model.
